info.title: BEE local API contract
info.summary: Existing local routes of the Next.js portal boundary and the Spring API (WP03.1).
info.description:
Local MacBook runtime only (ADR-001 D-RT2). The Next.js same-origin route handlers are the browser-facing boundary; the single Spring API is the authority. There is no separate gateway.

- Authority: Spring decides every read from bee_app database rows (account, membership, role, assignment). Token organisation claims are ignored.
- MFA: Spring requires amr to contain pwd and otp on every authenticated route (403 mfa_required); Next.js also refuses to create a session without it.
- No browser bearer token: the browser holds only the opaque bee_session cookie. Tokens stay in the Next.js server session; a browser Authorization header is ignored.
- No-store: every response of both layers carries Cache-Control including no-store.
- Not found: out-of-scope, unknown and malformed model IDs return an identical 404 not_found.
- Default deny: every Spring method/path not listed here returns 401 unauthenticated without a token and 403 denied_by_default with one. Draft create and edit (POST/PATCH on runtime model applications) are operational; submit, fee, transitions and history remain deferred.
- Correlation: see components.headers.CorrelationId.

Version policy: info.version is the contract version (semver). 0.5.0 added local test-report document intake (list, multipart upload, PDF content). 0.3.0 added the two browser-facing model reads and tightened ModelApplication (state enum, readBasis pattern, version >= 0). 0.2.0 closed Me.ignoredTokenClaims and made the Next boundary enforce the Me schema and per-operation error codes. Patch = wording/examples; minor = new optional field, new route or new error code; major = removed/renamed field, changed status or code meaning. URL paths are not versioned (no /v1 aliases) while the API is local-only; scripts/local/contract-check.cjs and scripts/local/api-contract.test.mjs fail when code and this file disagree.

get.summary: One model application for this browser's server session, if Spring lets it read it.
get.description: Next.js does not check the ID's shape, cache, or redirect, so it never answers for a record itself. The ID goes to Spring as one path segment; a value that cannot travel safely as one segment is replaced by a fixed non-UUID that Spring answers like any malformed ID. Out-of-scope, unknown, malformed and stale-assignment IDs therefore get the same 404 after Spring's identity and scope checks.

springBearer.description: Keycloak bee-local access token. Held only by the Next.js server session; never sent to or by the browser.

portalSession.name: bee_session
portalSession.description: Opaque random session ID (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax). Created only after password + TOTP sign-in and a Spring 200 on /api/me.

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-Id
CorrelationId.description: Optional caller ID matching ^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$. Kept if safe; otherwise replaced by a new UUID. Never an authorization input.

Present on every response, success or denial. Next.js accepts a safe incoming value or issues a UUID, sends it to Spring, and returns the same value. Spring applies the same rule to direct callers. Logged with method, path (no query), status and duration only.

Error.description: The one error body of both layers. The correlation ID is in the X-Correlation-Id header, not the body. message is fixed per code and never includes record IDs, tokens, SQL, stack traces or Keycloak detail.

authMethods.description: Token amr; always contains pwd and otp on a 200.

ignoredTokenClaims.description: Token attributes shown for transparency and never used for access.

version.description: Persisted row version; the expected-version input of future writes (409 version_conflict).

readBasis.description: Which database rule allowed the read (own-org, assigned, stage:<state>).

laboratoryCode.description: Laboratory that tested the model (WP05.1d). Chosen from the accreditation master's laboratories; whether it holds an active accreditation on the test date is checked at submit.

testedOn.description: Date of the test report (WP05.1d), YYYY-MM-DD; not after today (India date).

declaredIseer.description: Efficiency figure declared by the applicant (WP05.1d): positive, at most 99.99, at most two decimals (enforced by Spring on write; the BFF forwards writes unchanged and validates only responses). The rating step recomputes and records its own.

testedOn.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); omitted when not supplied.

laboratoryName.description: Free text as typed by the uploader; not verified. Omitted when not supplied.

DocumentUploadForm.description: multipart/form-data parts. file must be a PDF (starts with %PDF-, name ending .pdf, at most the local upload limit, 5 MiB by default). reportLabel is 1-120 characters; laboratoryName at most 120. Any violation is 422 validation_failed.

EligibleLaboratory.description: A laboratory with at least one accreditation record for the category. Whether one covers the test date is decided at submit.

version.description: The record version the user saw; a different stored version is 409 version_conflict.

receiptReference.description: The payment or receipt reference Finance saw (1 to 64 characters).

receivedOn.description: Date the money was received, YYYY-MM-DD, not after today (India date).

amountInr.description: Amount received in rupees; must equal the fee snapshot's amount exactly (422 amount_mismatch).

FeeConfirmationRequest.description: Request body of POST /api/model-applications/{id}/fee-confirmation (first slice step 2). Provisional local rules, not BEE rules.

FeeConfirmationReceipt.description: The answer to a fee confirmation. A receipt, not an application view: Finance reads only the fee_due stage, so a replay must not return a record it can no longer read.

version.description: The record version the officer saw; a different stored version is 409 version_conflict.

verification.description: The officer's finding on the uploaded test report (decision B8, provisional): the system itself makes no accreditation, authenticity or malware claim.

note.description: The officer's note, 1 to 500 characters, no control characters.

IameRecommendationRequest.description: Request body of POST /api/model-applications/{id}/iame-recommendation (first slice step 3). Provisional local rules, not BEE rules.

IameRecommendationReceipt.description: The answer to an IAME recommendation. A receipt, not an application view: after the move the officer no longer holds the assignment and cannot read the record, so a replay must not return it.

version.description: The record version the reviewer saw; a different stored version is 409 version_conflict.

note.description: The reviewer's note for the Programme team, 1 to 500 characters, no control characters.

ReviewerForwardRequest.description: Request body of POST /api/model-applications/{id}/reviewer-forward (first slice step 4). Provisional local rules, not BEE rules.

ReviewerForwardReceipt.description: The answer to a Reviewer forward. A receipt, not an application view: the reviewer's assignment ends with the move, so a replay must not return a record the reviewer can no longer read.

unauthenticated.message: A valid access token is required.
unauthenticated.when: No, expired or invalid bearer token on a Spring route.

denied_by_default.when: Authenticated call to any method or path Spring does not map (writes, history, actuator other than health). Default deny.

mfa_required.message: Sign-in must include a verified one-time code.
mfa_required.when: Token amr lacks both pwd and otp.

no_active_account.message: There is no active BEE account for this identity.
no_active_account.when: Subject has no active bee_app account (or is not a UUID).

no_effective_role.message: There is no active BEE role for this identity.
no_effective_role.when: No database role that is active, in date and also carried by the token.

no_read_scope.message: This role has no read access to model applications.
no_read_scope.when: Role has no model-application read rule.

not_found.message: No such record is available to you.
not_found.when: Unknown, malformed, out-of-scope or stale-assignment model ID, or an unmatched GET path under an allowed prefix. Byte-identical body in every case.

service_unavailable.message: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
service_unavailable.when: Spring's database (or another dependency) failed during an allowed request.

internal_error.message: The request could not be completed.
internal_error.when: Unexpected Spring failure. Logged by class name with the correlation ID; never shown to the browser (Next maps it to 502 api_error).

no_session.when: No, unknown or forged bee_session cookie. A browser Authorization header is ignored.

session_expired.message: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
session_expired.when: Server session reached its end or Keycloak refused the refresh; cookie cleared.

identity_unavailable.message: The identity service is not reachable. Try again later.
identity_unavailable.when: Keycloak unreachable while refreshing the session.

api_unreachable.message: The BEE service is not reachable. Try again later.
api_unreachable.when: Spring did not answer within 3 s (down or refused).

invalid_api_response.message: The BEE service returned an unexpected response.
invalid_api_response.when: Spring answered 200 with a body that is not JSON or does not match the operation's schema exactly (missing, mistyped or undocumented field). The body is discarded.

api_error.message: The BEE service could not complete the request.
api_error.when: Spring answered with a status/code pair not documented for the operation (for example 500 internal_error, or an unknown code). Spring's text is discarded.

cross_origin.message: This request must come from the BEE portal.
cross_origin.when: Logout POST without the portal's own Origin header.

method_not_allowed.message: This method is not supported for this resource.
method_not_allowed.when: Unsupported method on a browser-facing route; Allow header lists the method.

no_write_scope.message: This role cannot create or edit model application drafts.
no_write_scope.when: Partner role without draft write scope.

brand_not_permitted.message: This brand is not available to your organisation.
brand_not_permitted.when: Brand not owned or not authorised.

not_editable.message: Only draft applications can be edited.

validation_failed.message: The request could not be accepted.

version_conflict.message: The record has changed since it was loaded.

idempotency_key_required.message: An Idempotency-Key header is required for this request.

idempotency_key_conflict.message: This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different request body.

idempotency_in_progress.message: A request with this Idempotency-Key is still in progress.

not_submittable.message: Only draft applications can be submitted.
not_submittable.when: Submit when state is not draft.

rule_not_available.message: Required category, standard or fee rules are not available.
rule_not_available.when: Effective master rules missing at submit time (fail closed).

fee_preview_conflict.message: The provisional fee changed since it was reviewed.
fee_preview_conflict.when: POST submit when resolved fee differs from expectedFee in the request body.

test_report_required.message: A test report must be uploaded before the application can be submitted.
test_report_required.when: POST submit when the application has no test report version.

declared_efficiency_required.message: The declared efficiency figure is required before the application can be submitted.
declared_efficiency_required.when: POST submit when the declared efficiency figure is missing.

test_date_invalid.message: A test date that is not in the future is required before the application can be submitted.
test_date_invalid.when: POST submit when the test date is missing or in the future.

laboratory_not_accredited.message: The laboratory must hold an active accreditation for this category on the test date.
laboratory_not_accredited.when: POST submit when the laboratory is missing or holds no active accreditation for the category on the test date.

standard_not_available.message: No applicable standard is in force on the test date.
standard_not_available.when: POST submit when no standard is in force for the category on the test date.

duplicate_model.message: Another application already holds this brand and model number.
duplicate_model.when: POST submit when another non-draft, non-rejected application holds the same brand and normalised model number.

role_not_permitted.message: This role cannot perform this action.
role_not_permitted.when: POST fee-confirmation when the caller's role may not perform the action (not Finance, or no read scope).

segregation_refused.message: A person who acted at another stage of this application, or its own organisation, cannot take this step.
segregation_refused.when: POST fee-confirmation when the caller belongs to the paying organisation or already acted at another stage of the application.

amount_mismatch.message: The amount received does not match the fee due.
amount_mismatch.when: POST fee-confirmation when the amount received differs from the fee snapshot.

assignee_unavailable.message: No officer is available to take the next stage.
assignee_unavailable.when: POST fee-confirmation when no IAME officer is available to take the next stage; nothing is written.

x-bee-status-semantics.401: No usable credential (no token, no or expired session). Sign in again.
x-bee-status-semantics.403: Identity known but not allowed (MFA, account, role, read scope, default deny, wrong origin).
x-bee-status-semantics.404: Record not available to this caller; does not reveal whether it exists.
x-bee-status-semantics.405: Method not supported on a browser-facing route.
x-bee-status-semantics.409: Write conflict: stale version or idempotency (see x-bee-idempotency).
x-bee-status-semantics.422: Invalid write input or missing Idempotency-Key on draft create/patch.
x-bee-status-semantics.500: Unexpected Spring failure; internal only, mapped to 502 at the browser boundary.
x-bee-status-semantics.503: A dependency (Spring, its database or Keycloak) is unavailable; retry later.

browser.description: Any /api path or method on the portal without its own route returns 404 not_found in the Error body, with X-Correlation-Id and no-store (not the HTML page), for example /api/runtime/model-applications/{id}/history.

x-bee-idempotency.status: implemented in bee_app (WP05.1b draft create/edit; WP05.1c submit; WP06.1a document upload); see Flyway V7 idempotency_record

header.name: Idempotency-Key
header.description: Client-generated (UUID v4 recommended), one per user intent; required on every write command. Reads never take one.

x-bee-idempotency.scope: bee_app account id + HTTP method + route template + target record id. A key never matches across accounts, routes or records.
x-bee-idempotency.authorization: Spring re-evaluates identity, role and scope before any replay; a caller who has lost access gets the current denial, never the stored result.
x-bee-idempotency.stored: Key scope, SHA-256 of the canonical request body, response status and body, resulting record version, created time. Written in the same database transaction as the state change; local retention 24 hours.
x-bee-idempotency.replay: Same key, scope and body hash after completion: the original status and body with Idempotency-Replayed: true; no second state change or audit event.

conflicts.409 idempotency_key_conflict: Same key and scope, different body hash.
conflicts.409 idempotency_in_progress: Same key while the first request is still running.
conflicts.409 version_conflict: Expected record version (ModelApplication.version) differs from the persisted version; nothing is stored under the key.

x-bee-idempotency.boundary: Next.js validates the header syntax and forwards it unchanged with the session token; Spring owns the store and the decision.
x-bee-idempotency.upload: WP06.1a POST /api/model-applications/{id}/documents: the stored body hash is SHA-256 over the file bytes, documentKind, reportLabel, testedOn, laboratoryName and the sanitised file name (never the multipart boundary), so a retry with a fresh boundary and the same content replays; Next.js forwards the multipart body and Content-Type unchanged.

x-bee-default-deny.spring: Any method/path other than the routes listed here: 401 unauthenticated without a token, 403 denied_by_default with a valid token. Includes GET /api/model-applications/{id}/history, fee, transitions and /actuator/* other than health.
